It might seem strange, but we have found that many people are not familiar with the difference and connection between feather and down. According to the public opinion, it is only a matter of grade of fineness, if the two expressions appear in product specifications describing filling of pillows and quilts. Thought his is not far from reality, it is important to know, that there are more complete quality and technical details in question and these affect not only fineness, but other characteristics of the product concerning grade of comfort. The percentage of feather and down has influence on the filling power as well as on the weight of the ready-made product, the softness of the pillow, and also on insulation and water absorption capacity. These details are all very important for the product’s characteristics, durability, comfort and sanitary aspects during use. Just like feathers with a rigid shaft, soft down without shaft also comes from waterfowl. The difference is that former mentioned are typically located on the back of the animal, and soft, light down is located on the breast. Like feathers, down is also responsible for insulation of the body, but unlike the feathers, these are not exposed to harsh environmental effects, so – because of evolutional reasons-their structure is much lighter, airy. It is also important to note, that feathers are 2 dimensional and down are 3 dimensional: this is a basic difference that affects their characteristics and their use as a filling of bedding items. Generally speaking, down represents more quality than feathers, and one can obtain bigger down from the body of more mature animals, which provide bigger filling power, so higher quality. Raw material like this improves the durability of the product and also results in excellent insulation. Qualities: As a manufacturer of down and feather products, when assessing customer needs, an important question is which market we are producing the items for. The target markets determine the quality expectations of the filling material based on various internationally accepted standards. Into the pillows and duvets produced by us, we can put any filling material quality specified by IDFL standard. The expression filling power is a measure used worldwide to show how big space can be filled with a unit of down. The higher this number is, the better is the insulation capacity, and naturally the price of the filling and the ready-made product is higher. The reason for this is that we need less filling material of a higher quality down to reach the desired grade of comfort. Bigger down results in a lighter quilt and this in total ads on to the quality of sleep and well-being. Why is Hungarian down good? The natural conditions of our country- its climate, greenery, great areas of water side habitats- provide excellent conditions for the life of the waterfowl. The high quality, healthy filling of the bedding comes from the plumage of geese and duck kept here, and with the help of adequate expertise based on century-long experience, the products and producers of the Hungarian industry have become world-wide famous. The quality of down and feather is watched by the farmers already during the keeping of the animals. The birds are fed only with good quality feed of natural basis, the health of the ducks and geese is checked constantly and in case of suspecting any illness- according to the interest of the whole stock- they separate and start to vet animals in question. The strict control is valid not only for the animal keeping, but also for the processing of the feather, starting from the recollection through cleaning and classifying to the final usage. These high quality expectations and internationally acknowledged standards guarantee that the outstanding raw material results in outstanding, premium category items, that truly make Hungary be proud of them. Goose and duck down and feather characteristics: Down duvets and pillows are already of high quality compared to their synthetic counterparts. Since they are products of animal origin, the bedding item is always natural. The thermal insulation capacity of both goose and duck down is extremely good. Properly processed goose and duck down serves as an excellent filling material. Among their differences is that goose down is larger in size compared to duck down, thus providing better filling power. Due to this property, goose products can be classified as luxury quality on the market. Furthermore, the difference arising from the nature of the birds is that geese are purely herbivorous, while ducks are omnivorous. This diet also affects the plumage of the animals. Animal welfare: Hungária Down Ltd operates responsibly. Environmental consciousness and – originating from the industry’s peculiarity- animal protection and animal welfare are factors that we demand without exceptions and we corporate them in our activities at every stage of the production process. We require not only high quality raw material from our Hungarian and EC providers, but we also insist on their work according to our principals regarding environmental consciousness and animal welfare, as we all have a shared responsibility in this aspect. According to our principles and our customers’ expectations, we only purchase down as secondary product from the processing of water-fowl, but we require the down to comply with high standards of hygiene and also to have ideal filling power for our products. We do not use down or feather plucked from live animals. Magyar és más, európai uniós beszállítóinktól nem csupán a magas minőségű alapanyagot követeljük meg, hanem azt is, hogy maguk is ezek szellemében végezzék munkájukat, hiszen közös a felelősségünk ezen a téren. Saját elveinknek és vevőink elvárásainak megfelelően cégünk kizárólag a víziszárnyas-feldolgozás melléktermékeként keletkező, ugyanakkor magas tisztasági kritériumokhoz igazodó, termékeink szempontjából pedig ideális töltőerővel bíró pelyhet veszi át. Nem használunk fel élő állatról tépett tollat, pelyhet. Feather processing: Although for an outsider it might seem very simple how the feather and down become filling of bedding, in fact the production process requires complex, sophisticated machinery. Additionally, the procedure consists of different operations building on one another, so it requires time. All this is necessary, so that the consumers can rest among completely clean, healthy pillows and quilts suitable for their needs of comfort. The procedure starts with the recollection of feather and down originating from geese and ducks kept under strictly controlled circumstances. These are already pre-washed in the slaughterhouses, only after this do they arrive to the factories of processing companies. Here the raw material is being washed with chemicals and tumble dried, followed by drying at 110-120 grades Celsius and sterilization. Feather and down cleaned this way is guaranteed to be free of bacteria and virus. In the following stage of processing, precision equipments sort the feather and down according to their size; later on these are being re-mixed according to the market standards and costumer requirements. This is one of the reasons, why we experience during our journeys, that the softness of pillows is different, and quilts are lighter or heavier in our hotel rooms of USA, Canada or Asian countries. The freshly produced filling material is checked by a professional laboratory to ensure strict quality standards. During the testing, the filling material must meet a number of conditions and only then is it filled in the pillow and duvet. Scroll to Top.

Feather and down are used not only as a filling of bedding, but also in jackets and other clothing items, especially for winter. Still, our company profile is pillow and quilt production, so let’s have a look at these a little bit more into details. Pillow. Functionality makes the difference between pillows. While decorative cushions of different shapes, sizes and textures are determined to add to our comfort by their appearance, pillows used for sleeping are the key to our well-being, and – to be mentioned-, they have an important role in health preservation. It is easy to note that in case of the former mentioned category, we can find a huge variety of decorative pillows only limited by the imagination, due to the wide range of fillings, fabrics, also the endless options of shapes and colors. On the other hand, pillows produced for sleeping are the result of serious research and tests in case of every new product development. The production of pillows – as well as the production of quilts- is guided according to international standards, and the different phases of production are followed by quality control at every level; this is the only way we can guarantee that the products fulfill all technical criteria, distributor’s expectations and customer’s requirements as well. Pillows. Sleeping Pillows: We control the softness of sleeping pillows by the percentage of down content in the filling and by the quantity of filling material. The higher quantity of feather the mixture of the filling has, the harder the pillow is. It was an important step in the innovation of pillows, when multi-chamber pillows appeared; these may contribute in great extent to a comfortable feeling during the sleep. Two Chamber Pillow: In the two-chamber type there are two fillings of different physical characteristics, this gives a new functionality to the product. These pillows can be turned over: on one side there is 100% feather filling, which is cooler, so more suitable for summer use- on the other side of the pillow, the filling consists of 50% down and 50% feather, which is warmer, so more comfortable for winter, also gives more support to the head because of the filling power of the down. Three Chamber Pillows: Our three-chamber, premium pillows represent luxury on our scale of products.The 3 chambers provide the same function as the two-chamber version– summer and winter side- but the inner middle chamber increases the comfort of support for the user. Decorative Pillows: The decorative pillows made in our factory at Mezőkovácsháza are produced with white cotton fabric – free of optical whitener-, and typically with 100% feather filling. The fancy cover is exchangeable- the pattern, fabric and shape of the cushion- no matter whether it is square, triangle, round, rectangle or any other shape- are designed and adjusted to the production process according to the clients’ needs. Duvet. The other significant product group of our company consists of feather and down quilts, produced with several types of filling and grade of comfort in our factory at Mezőkovácsháza. Just like in case of the pillows, also in case of the quilts it is very important to choose adequate shell fabric. In case of Hungária Down Co. Ltd. this might be cotton, silk or satin (fabrics that are not down-proof are complemented with additional inner fabric), which we elaborate in different color and comfort versions according to the distributors’ and customers’ needs. As well as the fabrics, we also adjust the quality of the filling to our clients’ needs: the quality ordered may vary on a wide scale, starting from 50-50% feather and down to 100% down content. Breathability, wet absorption capacity and temperature conservation are much more important physical characteristics in case of the quilts than in case of the pillows. Among our company’s products you may find summer quilts, winter quilts, but so called four-season quilt types as well. We distinguish 5-5 different grades of warmness in case if the summer and winter versions. Duvets. Four Season Duvets: Four-season quilts are the combination of summer and winter quilts that can be varied by the costumer freely. The two different types can be attached or separated according to the customer’s needs and the conditions of temperature. Just like in case of the pillows, during the production of quilts we may also combine different functionalities To achieve the desired effect we use zone-technology, that is to say we use different mixture of down- of different quality and quantity- to fill the different chambers of the quilt. With this solution we can enhance the physical characteristics of filling materials, so we can control the warming and cooling capacity of the quilt. Winter and Spring-Autumn Duvets: Unlike the summer ones, here we can adapt to the warmth requested by our customers not only by the quantity of the filling, but also by varying the inner wall height, which can reach up to 7 centimeters. The use of the inner wall is realized in that the top and the bottom cotton fabric is joined together with the help of an internal strip,or wall. This internal wall gives the squares the opportunity to fill more filling into them, so the quilt becomes much warmer. The wall can be used not only on the inner walls, but also on the outer walls of the quilt. This element is called a gusset in technical terms, and in terms of its function, it again serves to fit more filling into the quilts. Summer Duvets: The majority of summer quilts are made in a stitched throught design. This design is reflected in the quilt’s properties in that the top and bottom cotton fabrics are sewn directly to each other when forming the squares. Typically, the squares of stiched through duvets are smaller, so the amount of filling is small, which is well suited to summer weather. Topper. In order to increase the sleeping comfort, not only the duvet can help us, but we can also cover our existing mattress with a topper filled with down. The layer filled with small down and feathers is a great complement to the mattress of the bed. In terms of its properties, the topper is 5-8 cm thick, its size is made according to the needs of our customers. We can make a topper for any mattress size available on the market. There is a strong rubber band on the bottom of the topper, in the four corners, which ensures that the topper fits well to the mattress and does not move during use. The topper is also made of 100% cotton material, but here we must take into account that due to its use, finely woven fabrics should be avoided. Using a topper not only has a positive effect on our own feeling of comfort, but also increases the lifespan of our existing mattress. Topper. Guidance of care. The care of natural-filled bedding is different from that of synthetic filling. Airing is one of the best ways to refresh the bedding and allow the down inside to regain its shape. However, for down and feather-filled bedding, the lowest temperature should be selected in the washing machine. The detergent used during washing should be gentle and fabric softener should not be used. Strong detergents can damage the down filling. When washing, select a low spin speed to avoid damaging the down filling. Before drying, it is important that the duvet is rinsed well with clean water so that detergent residues do not stick to the down filling and cotton fabric. We recommend two methods for drying: natural drying, when the washed bedding is left to dry in the open air. In this case, the down may clump together, but this can be corrected by shaking the duvet and moving it manually. Natural drying is a time-consuming process, so we must make sure that all parts of our bedding are completely dry. The second drying method is recommended in the dryer.
